services.name: Hog Canyon UTV Tour
services.desc: Hog Canyon Take off right from our parking lot for an adventurous ride up to the top of our signature red cliffs! Enjoy trails, a creek crossing and hill climbing trip that leads to great views. Hog Canyon is not far from Kanab so this is a quick tour that you can fit into your day in the area. services.name: Inchworm Arch UTV or 4WD Tour
services.desc: Be ready for a ride full of epic scenery, big expansive views and a total feeling of being “out there.“ This area is full of canyons, overlooks, bizarre rock formations, archaeology, and a spectacular and seldom seen Double Arch. Our Inchworm Arch Tour takes us through the Vermilion Cliffs “Step” of the Grand Staircase. The roads and routes to get there are a combination of rocky and thrilling with sections of deep sand. What to Bring Please bring a backpack Depending on the time of year, you may need a coat and warm hat Sunscreen, hats, sunglasses, and comfortable hiking/walking shoes are recommended Since it is a sand trail you may want to bring something to cover your face for the ride

services.name: South Fork Indian Canyon UTV Tour
services.desc: Invigorating ATV ride with Amazing Views This beautiful canyon lies nestled just north of Coral Pink Sand Dunes State Park. The head of the canyon features a natural spring that decorates the walls with lush greenery and water seeps. You will find plenty of shade along this trail, and at your destination, as the trail ends at a massive pictograph panel tucked inside a large alcove. The route is moderately challenging and does involve some steep steps and off-camber footing. There is a very secure rock pathway with a guardrail that extends down along the side of the canyon wall. This is a beautiful section of trail but could be slow-going for some and requires good balance and self

services.name: Alt Wave Adventure
services.desc: Maximum 9 Persons per 1 Guide The Alternate Wave Adventure. For those who may not have the fortune to win a permit, fear not. Kanab Tour Company's exclusive tour takes you into The Wave's overlooked neighbor. Join us for a tour with epic sandstone buttes, fins, waves and delicate lace rock outcroppings. The Alt Wave Adventure stands alone as a destination and is worthy alongside the region's great hikes. services.desc: ATV Bryce Canyon! Our tour wanders through the twisting forest and small streams to reach the edge of the fantastic Sunset Cliffs of Bryce. Please note that although this tour does not enter into Bryce Canyon National Park, the views gained through touring this way are some that few visitors will see. services.name: The Grand Staircase Round-Up UTV Tour
services.desc: If you want to find yourself in a truly wild, western space… come explore the Grand Staircase Escalante National Monument with us. Our 8 Hour Inchworm Arch - Great Chamber - Peek-a-Boo Slot Canyon Tour takes you through the Grand Staircase Escalante National Monument. The route is a combination of rock crawling and thrilling sections of deep sand. Getting you into the heart of remote, local scenery that is less visited. This tour is packed full of adventure and unforgettable views. services.desc: White Pocket! Maximum 6 Persons per 1 Guide Accessible by UTV or 4WD... Very stunning, and often overshadowed by The Wave, is the beautiful White Pocket. Experience something otherworldly while walking across the hexagonal rock formation. The streaks of red sand in the white rock are mesmerizing. The white rock is very bright, so sunglasses are a must for this tour. Also, it is very easy to get dehydrated on this tour, make sure to drink plenty of water throughout the day! checkin: PLEASE KEEP IN MIND - UTAH IS ON MOUNTAIN TIME. OUR TIME ZONE IS DIFFERENT THAN THE TIME ZONES IN LAS VEGAS, NV OR PAGE, AZ (depending on Daylight Savings). Our tours are based on current Utah time - Be sure to adjust your time to arrive accordingly! We will provide bottled water. Please wear weather appropriate clothing.
